title: Choosing Preprocessing Strategies knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Choosing Preprocessing Strategies”?
options: The method always performs better than a simple baseline, regardless of the task.
Preprocessing determines how raw values become model inputs. Fit learned transformations only on training data and reuse the fitted transformation unchanged at prediction time.
The method proves that every prediction will be correct on all future datasets.
The method removes the need to inspect data quality or define an evaluation strategy.
questions.answer_key: Preprocessing determines how raw values become model inputs. Fit learned transformations only on training data and reuse the fitted transformation unchanged at prediction time.
questions.explanation: The lesson frames the topic this way: Preprocessing determines how raw values become model inputs. Fit learned transformations only on training data and reuse the fitted transformation unchanged at prediction time. The other options make unsupported guarantees.

questions.prompt: What is a sound first step when applying “Choosing Preprocessing Strategies” to a new task?
options: Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Preprocessing for linear models; then test it on representative data.
Tune against the final test set until the preferred metric increases.
Remove records that produce unexpected outcomes without investigating them.
Assume the default parameters are best for every dataset.
questions.answer_key: Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Preprocessing for linear models; then test it on representative data.
questions.explanation: Define the input, output, assumptions, and evidence needed. For Preprocessing for linear models, a small representative check is more useful than blind tuning.

questions.prompt: What conclusion is appropriately cautious after trying “Choosing Preprocessing Strategies”?
options: A single successful run proves fairness, robustness, and production readiness.
A higher training score alone proves generalization to unseen data.
An internal estimator score replaces domain review and operational monitoring.
A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
questions.answer_key: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
questions.explanation: A demonstration only supports conclusions within its scope. Evaluate representative unseen cases and report limitations before production use.
